name: io.github.nirholas/trading-mcp
title: three.ws Trading
description: Quote and fill guarded Solana swaps from a three.ws agent wallet. Never sells $THREE.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: REQUIRED. The agent owner's three.ws credential (API key or OAuth access token), sent as Authorization: Bearer. Filling a trade needs the wallet:trade grant and the owner's signed real-funds agreement. This credential can move real funds via execute_trade: treat it like a password. THREE_WS_TOKEN / THREE_WS_BEARER are accepted aliases.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.
